title: Campaign: connectomes, whole-network organisation
abstract: Subcampaign of 'what do connectomes reveal about how nervous systems are built?'. Scope: Statistics of the whole wiring diagram: degree and weight distributions, wiring cost and layout, scaling laws, structure-function relations of whole networks. 17 papers. Status: supported. Heavy-tailed synapse-count distributions are mixtures of cell types (type predicts 89-90% of variance); the Rent exponent is 0.53-0.54 in two fly brains; recorded neuropil layouts are within 1.3-4% of the best layouts once cell bodies are fixed in a wire-length model (a null with real neuropil strengths reproduces 88-100% of the free-exchange saving); the strongest connections match across copies far more than a prune-and-regrow model predicts.
